name: mylapore-express-monorepo
description: Mylapore Express Enterprise Restaurant E-commerce Platform

scripts.build: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" build && pnpm --filter @mylapore/api build && pnpm --filter @mylapore/web build
scripts.build:api: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" build && pnpm --filter @mylapore/api prisma:generate:pg && pnpm --filter @mylapore/api build
